phases.purpose: Establish the authored standing baseline. This is not a foot-position or skin-contact acceptance claim.
Bend and reach through the explicit hip, spinal, cervical and arm commands; inspect whole-chain orientation and support.
Retain the commanded reach endpoint while observing all bones and skin; numerical stabilization bounds remain unqualified.
Return to the authored standing targets and inspect support continuity.
Inspect end-to-start replay continuity. The recipe does not declare a cyclic loop; no loop motion or tolerance is invented.

intentGaps.description: Hips has no direct target. Decide and reference the intended pelvic articulation/root relationship; inherited foot-root placement is not declared stabilization.
Head and eye task roles are undeclared. Decide whether gaze/head should inherit, counter-rotate, or remain locally stabilized, with reference support before adding motion.
No digit targets or digit stabilization contract. Decide the relaxed-rest versus task-specific reaching hand shape and any supported local excursion bounds. Do not infer a held role from omission.

Non-driven source helpers retain baseline locals and inherit parents. Their task role, local preservation purpose, and acceptable skin/deformation bounds require deliberate review; hierarchy alone does not establish stabilization.

The root uses inferred standing foot-root placement with a 5cm trigger; no explicit fixed bilateral contact schedule is authored. Choose/reference intended support behavior before declaring contact rows or a support tolerance.

Explicit shoulder flexion is scalar-compensated by trunk flexion before girdle and humeral construction. Compare trunk-relative orientation and skin in Blender; no corrected shoulder trajectory is established.
Explicit lumbar/thoracic/cervical commands exist, but task-supported distribution and timing through pelvis, both thoracic segments, both neck segments and head remain unqualified.

Available protocol records do not justify per-bone local/world angular or positional trajectory bounds. Retain rules:[] and constraintStatus:unqualified; existing clinical/patient limits remain separate and unchanged.
Detailed feet-together, fingertip-to-toe, gaze and curvature criteria have not been verified from retained primary illustrations; generic wrist-height tests are not a substitute.
Retained native failures use older routes and different durations. Fresh exact-source native reproduction is required after source/Blender review; contact/clinical/controller limits stay unchanged.
